an7.19:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] sattime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa. katame satta: idha bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:1.2: so āsavānaṃ khayā [anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ] …pe… sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an7.19:1.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, paṭhamo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… [anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ] lokassa.
an7.19:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:2.2: tassa apubbaṃ acarimaṃ āsavapariyādānañca hoti jīvitapariyādānañca.
an7.19:2.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave, dutiyo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… [anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ] lokassa.
an7.19:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave, idhekacco puggalo nibbāne sukhānupassī viharati sukhasaññī sukhapaṭisaṃvedī satataṃ samitaṃ abbokiṇṇaṃ cetasā adhimuccamāno paññāya pariyogāhamāno.
an7.19:3.2: so pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saññojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti …pe…
an7.19:3.7: ayaṃ bhikkhave, sattamo puggalo āhuneyyo …pe… lokassa.
an7.19:3.8: ime kho bhikkhave, satta puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
